title: Echo Mod
description: A mod that adds EchoLocation to Minecraft.
body:
# Echo Mod

A Fabric 1.21.1 only (Currently) mod that adds echolocation to Minecraft. With integration of [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat).

## How does it work?
- The world gets entirely black and you won't be able to see anything that doesn't make sound, it includes many of the blocks of the game
- To see, you have to make a sound, and outlines will appear around the sound's source, the outline strenght is a variable that depends on how loud the noise was.

## Commands

- `/echoloc toggle <targets>`
- `/echoloc on <targets>`
- `/echoloc off <targets>`
- `/echoloc true|false <targets>`

Requires level 2 operator benefits, aka /op.

## Instalation and Dependencies

Install in the client and server:

- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API for Minecraft 1.21.1
- Echo Mod


## Incompatibilities

The only mods that I registered incompatibility is:

- Iris Shader

Unfortunately, no shaders for now.




Now for the [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) integration, the louder your audio is, the more you will be able to see.

[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat), [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) and [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) are opitional but recommended due to the lag some things can make and it may run poorly on old PCs.


Optimization is always welcome.


### Story of this mod (For the ones that need to know)
I made that mod using Codex, which is vibe coding, I made this mod trying to make a feature on a server the fast as possible without knowing how to code and then I ended up with something that I liked so much that I decided to properly publish this on Modrinth :3
